name: receipt-verifier-workspace
description: Development workspace for an embedded Ethiopian payment receipt verification library

scripts.check:env: vp run @1hubengineering/receipt-verifier-cli#check:env && vp run @1hubengineering/receipt-verifier-adapter-contract#check:env && vp run @1hubengineering/receipt-verifier-worker#check:env && vp run @1hubengineering/receipt-verifier-fastify-checkout#check:env
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit --project packages/verifier/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project packages/provider-cbe/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project packages/storage-sql/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project packages/adapter-drizzle/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project packages/adapter-prisma/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project examples/checkout-web/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: vp test run && vp run @1hubengineering/receipt-verifier-checkout-web#test && vp run @1hubengineering/receipt-verifier-adapter-contract#test
scripts.verify: vp run check:env && vp run generate && vp run build && vp run check:drizzle && vp run check && vp run typecheck && vp run test && vp run test:reference && vp run check:package && vp run build:site && vp run docs:smoke
